features.name: Shell tool
features.summary: Runs shell commands for the agent through the approval gate and sandbox.

features.name: Local code execution
features.summary: Runs Python and Node with the shared execution policy and explicitly approved per-call elevation.

features.name: Sub-agents
features.summary: Delegates bounded work to background child agents with their own budgets.

features.name: Web search
features.summary: Searches and fetches the web for the agent, including DeepSeek Search (web.run, with the web_search alias).

features.name: apply_patch
features.summary: Edits files with structured patches the user can review and undo.

features.name: MCP client
features.summary: Connects local stdio and remote HTTP MCP servers and exposes their tools.

features.name: Execution policy
features.summary: Decides allow, ask or deny for each tool call from layered permission rules.

features.name: Vision model
features.summary: Routes image analysis to a separate vision-capable model configured in [vision_model].

features.name: verify tool
features.summary: Lets the agent ask for an adversarial self-critique of its own work.

features.name: Code mode
features.summary: execute_tools programs compose MCP, plugin and native tool calls under the normal gate.

features.name: Extension host
features.summary: Runs reviewed plugins' native TypeScript/JavaScript tool and slash-command code in a Bun or Node sidecar.

features.name: Finance host
features.summary: Routes opted-in finance tools through the bundled Native host under the existing permission and sandbox gates.

features.name: Data host
features.summary: Routes opted-in data validation through the bundled Native host with owned input and output bounds.

features.name: Speech host
features.summary: Routes opted-in speech tools through the bundled Native host while Rust retains credentials and permissions.

features.name: PDF host
features.summary: Routes opted-in PDF extraction through the bundled Native host with the same Rust path and size guards.

features.name: OCR host
features.summary: Routes opted-in image OCR through the bundled Native host under existing media and permission guards.

features.name: GitHub host
features.summary: Routes opted-in GitHub operations through the bundled Native host while Rust retains credentials and approvals.

features.name: Web search host
features.summary: Routes opted-in web search through the bundled Native host with the existing Rust credential and network gates.

features.name: Web extract host
features.summary: Routes opted-in web extraction through the bundled Native host with owned URL and response bounds.

features.name: Review host
features.summary: Routes opted-in review tools through the bundled Native host while Rust retains route and permission authority.

features.name: Modes
features.summary: Plan, Work and Operate modes set what the agent may do in a session; a finished plan offers to start the work.

features.name: Permission postures
features.summary: Ask, Auto-Review and Full Access postures decide when a tool call needs approval.

features.name: Command sandbox
features.summary: Wraps commands in Seatbelt on macOS; bubblewrap on Linux is on by default once installed and verified.

features.name: Providers
features.summary: Provider routes with endpoint-scoped model facts, explicit limits and sourced price estimates.

features.name: Auto model routing
features.summary: Picks a model per turn under Auto; /router sets up the router.

features.name: Fleet
features.summary: Runs and supervises groups of worker agents with receipts and a pre-spend check.

features.name: Environment-aware Fleet placement
features.summary: Places Fleet tasks by environment requirements and connects explicitly configured workers through Tailscale.

features.name: Workflows
features.summary: Checked-in .workflow.js scripts coordinate agents step by step.

features.name: Automatic workflows
features.summary: Turns a broad request into a compact Workflow plan without writing a script.

features.name: Goals
features.summary: /goal keeps the agent working toward one objective across turns.

features.name: Todo list
features.summary: The agent keeps a visible todo list for multi-step work.

features.name: Queue and steer
features.summary: Queue messages while a turn runs, or steer the running turn.

features.name: Receipts
features.summary: /receipts lists what a session did: files, commands, calls, approvals and failures.

features.name: Request preview
features.summary: /preview-request shows the redacted outbound request without sending it.

features.name: read_media
features.summary: Reads and preprocesses images for vision-capable models with size and privacy guards.

features.name: User memory
features.summary: Opt-in local store of preferences and conventions that persists across sessions.

features.name: Skills
features.summary: Installs and loads trusted instruction packages with owned-root precedence and separate user/model invocation controls.

features.name: Plugins
features.summary: Installs, reviews and trusts plugin bundles, including the first-party marketplace.

features.name: Computer Use
features.summary: Reviewed app control with consent, fresh element targets, observation diffs and bounded named action batches.

features.name: Script tools
features.summary: Scripts in ~/.codewhale/tools become approval-gated tools; [tools.overrides] disables built-ins, never replaces them.

features.name: Claude plugin compatibility
features.summary: Loads Claude Code plugin bundles and skill folders where their features are supported.

features.name: Claude settings import
features.summary: /import-claude plans a reviewable import of Claude Code settings and servers.

features.name: Hooks
features.summary: Runs user commands on session and tool events, with an execution receipt after shell tools.

features.name: LSP diagnostics
features.summary: Feeds language-server diagnostics to the agent; custom servers can be added.

features.name: Runtime API
features.summary: Local API: threads, events, approvals, project trust, workspace leases, Unix store sockets and scoped device tokens.

features.name: Headless exec
features.summary: codewhale exec runs one headless turn from a script and streams JSON.

features.name: GitHub PR review
features.summary: codewhale review --pr N writes an advisory review; posting to GitHub is opt-in.

features.name: Local browser client
features.summary: codewhale web opens the embedded browser client on 127.0.0.1 over the Runtime API.

features.name: Keybindings
features.summary: Terminal key bindings, documented from the keybinding catalog.

features.name: Settings
features.summary: /config and codewhale config edit settings declared once in the settings schema.

features.name: What's new after an update
features.summary: Says once, on the first start after an update, what changed and links that version's release notes.

features.name: Themes
features.summary: /theme picks a built-in theme; user themes follow a JSON schema.

features.name: Chat color
features.summary: /color gives one chat's composer box its own color, kept with that session.

features.name: Localization
features.summary: Interface text in 15 locales.

features.name: Voice input
features.summary: /voice, /voicecontrol and /voicesend use the selected ASR backend without switching providers.

features.name: Pet
features.summary: Shared whale activity and reply views; desktop and app-server turns can follow an idle existing companion.

features.name: Home dashboard
features.summary: /overview shows the home dashboard.

features.name: Account login
features.summary: /login signs in to an optional Codewhale account; plugin providers connect with /connect.

features.name: Account computer files
features.summary: Save computer files as account versions, restore with revision checks, and download verified bytes.

features.name: Context anchors
features.summary: /anchor pins a fact that survives compaction.

features.name: Pin window
features.summary: /pin keeps the terminal window on top.

features.name: Structured copy
features.summary: /structcopy copies one session object as redacted JSON.

features.name: Live thinking
features.summary: /verbose toggles live model thinking in the transcript.

features.name: Workbar
features.summary: /workbar places the tasks, agents and context bar on any edge or hides it.

features.name: Terminal dock
features.summary: /workbar terminal shows workspace PTYs with live output, human input, session selection and a fresh shell; macOS/Linux.

features.name: Telemetry
features.summary: Anonymous aggregate usage counts, disclosed at first launch, with a saved off switch.

features.name: Docker image
features.summary: Runs Codewhale in a container, with an opt-in toolbox image.

features.name: Android (Termux)
features.summary: arm64 release archive for Termux on Android.

features.name: Sign in with ChatGPT
features.summary: Uses official OAuth and the selected account catalog for eligible ChatGPT plan requests in the local OSS app.

features.name: Sign in with Claude
features.summary: Adds Claude subscription sign-in and native Messages routing. Live provider acceptance remains unverified.

features.name: Reviewed plugin OAuth providers
features.summary: Reviewed plugins sign in with /connect <id> and out with /disconnect; the host owns PKCE, models and approvals.

features.name: Sign in with OrcaRouter
features.summary: OrcaRouter provider: sk-orca- API key or OAuth 2.0 + PKCE sign-in, plus a live chat model catalog.

features.name: Merch interest list
features.summary: The community website collects private merch opt-ins, material preferences and optional item-price feedback.

features.name: Profile constitution
features.summary: Account preferences are captured per turn and previewed by the Engine.

features.name: Plugin shell installation
features.summary: codewhale install uses the reviewed bundle installer with local, GitHub and version-pinned npm sources.

features.name: Fork prefix inheritance
features.summary: Allows matching first-level Chat Completions forks to reuse a parent request header.

features.name: Fork trial diagnostics
features.summary: Opt-in JSON stderr observations of classified fork decisions and actual first-response cache usage.

features.name: Source navigation echoes
features.summary: File and search results include bounded source symbols, neighboring files and change attribution.
